modules.name: Family and Members
modules.description: Lets a resident keep a family list of members with relations and birth years, grouped by age group and counted for the flat and project.

requirements.title: Auto-add head of family
requirements.description: When a resident (owner or tenant) is approved, they are added automatically as member 1 with relation Self.

requirements.title: Add, edit, remove member
requirements.description: A resident can add, edit and remove a member using name, relation and birth year. The member shows in My Family and counts update on save.

requirements.title: Age group from birth year
requirements.description: Each member is placed in the matching age group based on their birth year.

requirements.title: Yearly age group update
requirements.description: On 1 January, members move to their new age group automatically.

requirements.title: Age group setup
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin sets age group names and limits on web, with defaults Kids 0–17, Adults 18–59 and Seniors 60+. All counts recalculate after a change.

requirements.title: Age Not Given count
requirements.description: A member with no birth year is counted under Age Not Given.

requirements.title: Duplicate member warning
requirements.description: A warning shows on mobile when the same name and birth year exist in another flat of the project. This is a Should priority.

requirements.title: Handle owner or tenant change
requirements.description: When a main user is deactivated, that family leaves all counts and its history is kept.

rules.title: Only resident can edit members
rules.description: Only the resident can edit their family members.

rules.title: Member limit of 15 per flat
rules.description: A flat with 15 members cannot add another. The addition is blocked with a message.
